name: G7 T3 W03 - Interpret charts and calculations
description: Optional review. No required vocabulary task this week. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: An expression that tells a spreadsheet how to calculate a result.
words.example: The formula =B2+B3 adds two cell values.

words.definition: The amount found by adding all the relevant values.
words.example: The total is the number of bottles collected by all teams.

words.definition: A number found by adding the values and dividing by how many values there are.
A picture that presents data so people can compare or understand it.
words.example: The chart uses bars to compare the club counts.

words.definition: A check of how two things are similar or different.
words.example: Our comparison shows that chess has more students than art.
